content: gdUnit4.api5.1.0-rc7 published Nov7 supports Godot4.7+, net8/net10,CSharp14; paired adapter3.2.0 and analyzers1.1.0 published. NuGet release notes specify headless SubViewport input but screenshots/shaders require display. Adapter uses VSTest, whereas donor global.json selects MTP. Separate runner scopes required. Framework does not replace four-process E2E orchestration. Sources https://github.com/godot-gdunit-labs/gdUnit4Net https://www.nuget.org/packages/gdUnit4.api/5.1.0-rc7 https://feed.nuget.org/packages/gdUnit4.test.adapter/3.2.0
